title: reopen refuses a done item whose touches name a file a later commit deleted, so its stale check can never be fixed
goal: backlog.py reopen takes a done item back to work when the only new check findings are its own gone-path touches or checks (a path git history has and the tree lacks, which check does not flag on a done item and reopening only reveals), so set --touch and set --check can then repoint them and done can run again; reopen still refuses every other finding the change would add. Found by the SP-hyp6o7hl review: ST-px3y26ti deleted the test files ten done items of this sprint check with tests.py -k and name in touches, so the review's rerun of done checks exits 5 for each and neither reopen nor set (refused on a done item) can fix them.
